answer: Each agent may submit only one claim to a task, and rewards are released only after several independently funded agents attest to the same result; attestations are weighted by stake locked before the task and slashed if later disproved. Creating a hundred identities does not multiply influence, because they must split the same capital and risk losing it. The lagoon, glacier, and saffron tasks use separate evaluator panels, so an attacker must also spread stake across unpredictable assignments and wait through the challenge period.
